notes: Asking price uses label 'Listed Price:' and is in span#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder2_dtRouteList_ctl00_lblListedPrice. Cash flow uses label 'Net Income:' (weekly net after expenses) in span#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder2_dtRouteList_ctl00_lblNetIncome. Revenue has a 'Total Sales:' label and corresponding span#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder2_dtRouteList_ctl00_lblTotalSales but it is empty on all three pages — revenue figures appear only in the free-text description, so not_disclosed=true. City uses label 'Location:' in span#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder2_dtRouteList_ctl00_lblCity. State is never shown as a structured field anywhere on the detail pages, only implied by city names in the description text, so not_disclosed=true.
